literal: By relatives, to be surrounded, living, wealth indeed, by acquiring, obtained benefit.
translation: Living surrounded by one's relatives is the true benefit obtained by acquiring wealth.
modern: தன் சுற்றத்தாரால் சூழப்பட்டு வாழும் வாழ்க்கை முறையே, ஒருவன் செல்வத்தைப் பெற்றதனால் அடையும் உண்மையான பயனாகும்.
explanation: This couplet explains the ultimate purpose of acquiring material wealth. The author states that the real fruit (பயன்) of possessing wealth (செல்வம்) is the ability to live a life surrounded (சுற்றப்பட) and supported by one's relatives (சுற்றம்). The word 'ஒழுகல்' refers to one's conduct and way of living. Thus, wealth is not an end in itself, but a means to foster and cherish a close-knit community of kinsmen.
